INTRODUCTION TO 
ARTIFICIAL 
INTELLIGENCE
By
Dr. Poulami Das
Goals of the Course
Some Fundamental Questions

Artificial Intelligence - Definition
• Artificial
Intelligence
is
an
area
of
Computer Science that emphasizes the
creation of intelligent machines that work
and react like humans.
• Artificial
Intelligence
is
intelligence
exhibited by machines, rather than the
humans or animals.
Applications of Artificial Intelligence

In Agriculture
A firm called Blue River Technology has created a robot
known as See & Spray. It uses object detection like
computer vision technologies to control and spray
weedicide on cotton plants.
Another firm PEAT is developing an application known
as Plantix which checks defects and nutrient deficiencies
in the soil and abnormalities in plants using images.

In Gaming
There is a tremendous application of AI in the
gaming
industry.
There
is
a
firm
called
DeepMind, which has developed a game that
defeated Chess champ Garry Kasparov.
Another example is the First Encounter Assault
Recon, which is a first person shooter video
game.
“I always say I was the first knowledge worker whose job 
was threatened by a machine” – Garry Kasparov

In Space Exploration
AI is used extensively in space exploration. Space
exploration is used to analyze lots of data.
Astronomers used AI to sift through lots of data
from the Kepler telescope for identifying a solar
planet system.
Another instance of AI being used is Mars 2020
Rover. It is also known as AEGIS and is already on
MARS. The rover is used to target cameras for
performing investigations on MARS.

AI is instrumental in the case of self driving
vehicles. Firms like Waymo are deploying
their AI based public ride hailing service. The
AI system collects data from cameras, GPS,
vehicles radar, and cloud services to produce
control signals which operate the vehicle.
Another example is Tesla’s self driving car. AI
is
used
to
implement
image
detection,
computer vision and deep learning for making
cars which automatically drive and check
objects.
In Self-driving vehicles

Teacher and AI collaboration.
Differentiated and individualized learning.
Universal access for all students.
Support outside the classroom.
In Education

•Chatbots, virtual assistants, and business 
intelligence bots
•Targeted online advertising
•Predictive analytics
•Voice recognition
•Pattern recognition using Clustering
•Recommendation using Clustering
In Business

In Healthcare
Telemedicine.
Nanorobots for operations.
Medical chatbots.
Image Processing for detection of diseases.
Medical data analysis for prediction.
Automated prescription reading app.
In Everyday Life

Smart homes, Smart hotels, Smart Industries -
Smart Cities

“The
coming
era
of
Artificial
Intelligence will not be the era of
war,
but
be
the
era
of
deep
compassion, non-violence, and love.”
- Amit Ray, Pioneer of Compassionate AI Movement

Means to Overcome Barriers
(Conflict Management)

Conflict Management
   What do you understand by the term conflict?

Benefits of having a conflict:
If managed properly conflicts can lead to positive outcome.
Helps to analyze goals in real-time
Creates dialogue
Fosters creative solutions
Conflict helps to overcome individual psychological barriers by forcing people out of their traditional mode of thinking.
Higher decision quality especially when the resistance is strong

    Without conflict organizations and employees stagnate

Types of Conflict:
Interpersonal
Organizational
Technical
National and International

Conflict resolution Strategies:
Avoiding
Accommodating
Compromising
Forcing
Problem solving- Negotiating

Negotiating as the best strategy:


Cooperation is better than Competition
Parties can be trusted (Communication Pyramid)
Differences can be minimized
Mutually acceptable solution can be found
Communication Pyramid
